answer: Home pickup isn't available in Texas, so you'd need to book an appraisal appointment at a store instead. Because the car is leased, first check that your leasing company allows third-party buyouts, then get a dealer payoff quote from them (or sign the lease buyout authorization, form NW-LSE-1, and we'll request it for you), and bring that quote to your appointment. Also bring a physical photo ID for every owner on the title (mobile IDs are only accepted in Virginia), the current registration, all keys and remotes, the title if you have one in hand, and the odometer disclosure statement, form NW-ODO-2. Plan for the appointment to take about an hour.
